requirements.title: Preserve the family authority boundary
requirements.statement: The repository must own only family constitution, invariants, narrow shared contracts, seeds, conformance assets, relationship graphs, and family release records while keeping suite, capability, workspace, and harness responsibilities separate.
requirements.basis: The current operator request and DEC-0001 establish the multi-repository ownership planes.

validation.method: Inspect repository paths and packet contract surfaces for ownership-boundary violations.
validation.evidence_expected: Final inventory, review, and passing packet/harness validation.

requirements.title: Keep shared contracts narrow and capability semantics independent
requirements.statement: Common contracts must remain limited to identity, discovery, planning, permissions, completion, provenance, durable result references, and bundle verification; domain payloads and semantic engines remain capability-owned.
requirements.basis: Established family architecture in the current operator request.

validation.method: Validate packet schemas, seeds, architecture, and review findings against family boundaries.
validation.evidence_expected: Passing packet validator and boundary-focused review.

requirements.title: Preserve canonical identity-source provenance and bytes
requirements.statement: The v1.0 historical identity source must retain its observed bytes, former locator, current archive locator, current packet projection, digest, and limitations without becoming an instruction channel.
requirements.basis: The operator-directed source reconciliation and the established identity source.

validation.method: Compare SHA-256 digests and validate provenance metadata and source-registry links.

requirements.title: Keep foundation work implementation-free
requirements.statement: This task must not create capability engines, suite services, product packages, source-code roots, dependencies, or implementation readiness claims.
requirements.basis: Explicit repository-foundation-only scope in the current operator request.

validation.method: Inventory repository paths and dependency effects; review for implementation or readiness overclaim.
validation.evidence_expected: Final repository inventory and review record.

requirements.title: Validate and refresh through designated commands
requirements.statement: Packet and harness checks must be reproducible and read-only; generated integrity must be refreshed only through the designated packet and harness writers after source freeze and followed by final read-only validation.
requirements.basis: Project Blueprint high-assurance contract and current operator validation requirements.

validation.method: Run packet check, harness check, mutation tests, designated refreshes, and final read-only checks in the required order.
validation.evidence_expected: Bounded command evidence on the exact final local candidate.
